reviews.title: Temu Ad
reviews.text:
The app showed me that I only have 1 year and 20 days left to live and then proceeded to show me a temu advertisement. 

You would think that with such little time I have to live they would be a little more compassionate and not waste my precious moments with temu ads.

(I'm being sarcastic btw)

Anyhow, the app is entertaining for about 40 seconds until it reveals your ‘death time’ after that, there's nothing interesting.

I'm only giving it two stars because the temu advertisment made me laugh.

reviews.text:
I downloaded Countdown as a joke and now my refrigerator won’t look me in the eyes.

The app said I have 62 years left but after I tripped over my own charger it updated to:
“lol maybe not”

Every time I open it my phone starts sounding like a Victorian child with tuberculosis.

Also why does the app know when I’m in the bathroom. I got a notification that said:
“crazy position btw”

BRO LEAVE ME ALONE 😭

I tried deleting it and my microwave turned on by itself and cooked absolutely nothing for 14 seconds. The app then sent:
“nice try”

My dog barked at my phone once and the timer added 3 days. So apparently he negotiated for me.

Would not recommend unless you enjoy:
• psychological warfare
• random choir noises
• being bullied by an app made of PNGs
• feeling spiritually audited

One star because it called me “stinky” after my screen time hit 9 hours.
